increment_paragraph: **CG10-INDIRECT-ACCESS-SOLE-RESIDUALS round 4** (USER DECISION 2026-11-21: a round on the largest class, the callee contracts; gateway rule 66; Lean `QCore.TypedefScalarElement`, 6 audited theorems; [report](../../reports/cg10-indirect-access-sole-residuals-r4/README.md)). Round 3's census scripts on a fresh opt-in base run (1,150/2/3,645/7; 222 Unknown functions blocked by the indirect-access refusal alone) rank the class `uncontracted-callee-unread-actual` (40 functions alone, the same 40 as round 3) by each callee's body: 37 callees' honest contracts are custody questions (allocating out-parameters into the caller's members 13, owned constructors into members 6, containers 5, timer callbacks 4, the premised logger 3, reference counts 3, enqueues 2, a stream callback 1), so no declaration frees them; three are neutral. Declared and pinned at 66910c10 and 046accf6 in `librdkafka/lz4_stream.qv`: `rd_jitter`, `XXH32_finalize`, `XXH64_finalize` (every formal borrowed, scalar result; trusted assumptions, their bodies do not validate). Rule 66: rule 35's decayed array member actual whose element is spelled through a typedef (Clang states no desugared spelling for `uint32_t mem32[4]`) is read as rule 35 reads the builtin scalar every `TypedefDecl` of it in the unit resolves to; a pointer, record, qualified or disagreeing resolution keeps the refusal. Measured on the opt-in `current --monkey-linked` route over Fluent Bit 046accf6 (base `6acb901c` on tree `9b107caf1` vs tip `40a3b51e` on tree `1bcd0ebe4`): 1,150/2/3,645/7 -> 1,157/2/3,638/7, seven Unknown -> Safe moves (`rd_kafka_broker_update_reconnect_backoff`, `XXH32_digest_endian`, `XXH64_digest_endian`, `XXH32_digest`, `XXH64_digest`, and through rule 66 alone `LZ4_prepareTable`, `LZ4HC_clearTables`), each resting on a declared assumption; no Safe -> non-Safe move, no new Unsafe, no Pending moved; access rows 2,154 -> 2,148, alone 222 -> 218, leaves 9,066 -> 9,046. The class now blocks 37 alone. Pinned-route parity not run on this host (no inputs): corpus predicted the seven moves where analysed, system and slice none.

Ranked by each callee's body (scripts/rank.py): 1 freed by a contract alone, 2 by a contract and a reading, 37 by neither, their callees' honest contracts being custody questions: an allocating out-parameter whose slot is the caller's member 13 (cmt_mpack_consume_string_tag 5, ctr_mpack_consume_string_or_nil_tag 5, rd_kafka_gzip/lz4/snappy compressors 3; MEMBER-EFFECT-STORES, CG10-OWNED-OUT-PARAMETER-MEMBER-SLOT), an owned constructor into a member or returned 6 (rd_kafka_topic_partition_list_copy/new, rd_kafka_topic_partition_copy, rd_kafka_MemberDescription_new, rd_kafka_group_result_new; RK-TOPIC-PARTITION-LIST-CONSTRUCTORS), container element custody 5 (rd_list_elem, rd_list_find, rd_list_copy, mk_list_init 2; decision class 1), a timer callback 4 (rd_kafka_timer_start0; decision class 1), the premised logger with nested static-string actuals 3 (rd_kafka_log0), reference counts 3 (rd_atomic32_add, rd_kafka_q_fwd_set0, rd_kafka_HeartbeatRequest; decision class 3), an enqueue or timer-list insertion 2, a stream callback at a return-position cast view 1 (pb_encode_string; CG10-CAST-VIEW-RETURN-POSITION). Three neutral declarations pinned at 66910c10 and 046accf6 (rd_jitter, XXH32_finalize, XXH64_finalize; trusted, CG10-R4-NEUTRAL-DECLARATIONS-UNVALIDATED) and gateway rule 66 (a decayed array member whose element is a scalar typedef, read as rule 35 reads the scalar; QCore.TypedefScalarElement): +7 Unknown -> Safe (rd_kafka_broker_update_reconnect_backoff, XXH32/64_digest_endian, XXH32/64_digest, LZ4_prepareTable, LZ4HC_clearTables), no Safe -> non-Safe move, no new Unsafe; access rows 2,154 -> 2,148, leaves 9,066 -> 9,046. ledger.title: Round 4's three neutral declarations (rd_jitter, XXH32_finalize, XXH64_finalize) are trusted assumptions: their bodies do not validate
ledger.text: CG10-INDIRECT-ACCESS-SOLE-RESIDUALS round 4 declared rd_jitter (rdrand.c:130-133), XXH32_finalize (rdxxhash.c:290-348) and XXH64_finalize (:701-808) neutral in librdkafka/lz4_stream.qv, pinned at 66910c10 and 046accf6; seven opt-in Safe rows rest on them. None validates in its home unit on the opt-in run: rd_jitter's row is Unknown on `call to uncontracted function rd_rand` (a static helper, rand_r over a thread-local seed set by rd_seed), and both finalizers' rows on `unmodeled increment or decrement expression` (the tail walk's `*p++` and `p+=4`) and `unresolved resource identity ptr`. DISCHARGE: validate each body (rd_rand's thread-local seed read; the finalizers' pointer walk over a borrowed `const void *`), so the declarations become checked, or record the refusal that keeps them declared.

ledger.title: An allocating out-parameter handed a member slot of the caller's object (cmt/ctr_mpack_consume_string_tag, the librdkafka compressors) has no contract form
ledger.text: CG10-INDIRECT-ACCESS-SOLE-RESIDUALS round 4 census (opt-in current over Fluent Bit 046accf6, base 9b107caf1): 13 Unknown functions blocked by the indirect-access refusal alone call an uncontracted callee that allocates into an out-parameter whose actual is the address of a member of the caller's object: `return cmt_mpack_consume_string_tag(reader, &opts->description);` and four more unpack_* (cmt_mpack_utils.c:115-175, `*output_buffer = cfl_sds_create_size(len)` on success), five ctraces unpack_* through ctr_mpack_consume_string_or_nil_tag, and rd_kafka_msgset_writer_compress_gzip/lz4/snappy handing `&ciov->iov_base` to rd_kafka_gzip_compress, rd_kafka_lz4_compress and rd_kafka_snappy_compress_slice. A neutral declaration would hide the allocation; `resource_out` binds its obligation only to an automatic object (rule 11v). The honest statement is an owned value delivered into a member path of the caller's (formal's) object, which is MEMBER-EFFECT-STORES' store half. DISCHARGE: a contract form for an owned out-parameter whose slot is a member path, decided with MEMBER-EFFECT-STORES' field-link or custody-free-old-value premise, with Lean parity and a measured arbiter.

ledger.title: rd_kafka_topic_partition_list_new, rd_kafka_topic_partition_list_copy and rd_kafka_topic_partition_copy have no declaration
ledger.text: CG10-INDIRECT-ACCESS-SOLE-RESIDUALS round 4 census: four Unknown functions blocked by the indirect-access refusal alone store or return an owned result of an undeclared librdkafka constructor (rd_kafka_DeleteRecords_new and rd_kafka_ElectLeaders_new: rd_kafka_topic_partition_list_copy into the body's own allocation; rd_kafka_ListOffsetsResultInfo_new: rd_kafka_topic_partition_copy; rd_kafka_assignment_init: rd_kafka_topic_partition_list_new into `rk->rk_consumer.assignment.*`, a formal's members). rd_kafka_topic_partition_list_new (rdkafka_partition.c:2843-2852) returns an rd_calloc'd list (its own row Unknown on the uncontracted rd_kafka_topic_partition_list_grow); _list_copy (:3283-3292) and rd_kafka_topic_partition_copy (:2933-2940) copy elements through rd_kafka_topic_partition_update, which takes partition references. Declaring them `resource_return_owned` is honest for the list itself but changes the verdict of every caller (many corpus functions), and the reference half is decision class 3. DISCHARGE: a measured card declaring the constructors (owned result, nonnull where rd_calloc asserts), with the reference-count half decided, reporting every caller's move including any provisional Unsafe.
